title: chore: switch to `babel-preset-env`
body:
**What project are you opening a pull request for?**
- react-instantsearch (use v2 base)

**Summary**
Use https://github.com/babel/babel-preset-env to target only 2 last versions of browsers and IE9 (sad react only 😭)

see: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/1868

**Result**

Do we have access to browserstack or similar tool to test it live on other browsers?

comments.body:
> Do we have access to browserstack or similar tool to test it live on other browsers?

We do have a browserstack account, other than that I recommend VirtualBox + https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/tools/vms/.

Install this locally from an optic fiber source and then you can start IE9/10/11/Edge in 10s (literally) and even access a local server on your host machine.
